rationale: The order set up the President's Committee on Employment of the Handicapped, its Executive Committee and Advisory Council. Executive Order 11480 of September 9, 1969, section 6(a), expressly supersedes Executive Order 10994 and Executive Order 11018 and re-establishes the Committee under a new order, with a transfer of members and business in section 6(b); the supersession names this order, has no exception and reaches every clause. Executive Order 11018 only amended section 1(b). The order therefore had no force on 2026-10-14. The two history observations (an Office of the Federal Register API disposition note and a 1989 Office of the Federal Register table entry) are editorial leads that give only an upper bound of 1989-01-20; I did not rely on them and instead read the later order's own text. The recommended status is NO.
